TranslationContext: This file contains Unit Names for the Darkborn Elves Faction.

Translations.Comment: 暗黒 = darkness, 生まれし = born, 精霊 = elves. Dark elves with sinister, corrupted tone.
槍兵 = spearman/spear infantry. Dark elf foot soldiers with piercing weapons.
恐怖 = dread/terror, 守衛 = guard. Elite heavy infantry that radiates fear.
魔女 = witch. Dark magic users wielding sinister supernatural powers.
弩兵 = crossbowman. Deadly dark elf ranged troops with precision.
影 = shadow. Stealthy infiltrators and assassins moving unseen.
矢砲 = bolt thrower/missile artillery. Heavy siege weapon of dark elves.
猛禽 = raptor/bird of prey, 騎士 = knight. Fast and deadly elf cavalry.
騎馬兵 = cavalry/mounted warrior. Dark elf cavalry on ominous steeds.
戦車 = war chariot. Swift and merciless vehicle of dark elf warfare.
ヒドラ = hydra (katakana). Multi-headed mythological monster.
ハルピュイア = harpies (katakana). Flying monsters serving dark elves.
黒き = black, 竜 = dragon. Fearsome and terrifying dark dragon.
天馬 = pegasus/heavenly steed. Corrupted flying mount for dark elf heroes.
貴族 = nobility/noble. Cruel and cunning dark elf leader.
祭司 = priestess/priesthood. Female dark magic user and spiritual leader.
刺客 = assassin/murderer. Master of stealth with deadly precision.
